metadata.experiment: screening of vapour-pressure shortcuts for water boiling temperature
metadata.reference: IAPWS-IF97 saturation pressure (region 4) via iapws package 1.5.5
metadata.reference_unit: K; output is the IAPWS-IF97 reference boiling temperature
